Chokher Bali -LRB- চোখের বালি literally translated to `` sand in the eye '' , figuratively to `` constant irritant '' -RRB- is a Bengali drama film based on the novel Chokher Bali by Rabindranath Tagore .
Chokher Bali won the National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Bengali and was nominated for the Golden Leopard -LRB- Best Film -RRB- award at the Locarno International Film Festival in 2003 .
